schema.name: resolved_at
schema.description: When a sweep found this insight stale and resolved it. NULL while it is open, and on rows resolved before this column existed.

schema.name: dismissed_at
schema.description: When an operator dismissed this insight. NULL means nobody has. Separate from status, which is what the pipeline decided rather than what a human did.

schema.name: merged_into_insight_id
schema.description: The insight an operator judged this one a duplicate of. Always names a row whose own pointer is NULL: merges flatten as they are written, so the depth is never more than one.

schema.name: merged_at
schema.description: When that judgement was made. NULL alongside a NULL merged_into_insight_id.
